name: Nicanzil, Current Conductor
oracle_text:
Whenever a creature you control explores a land card, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Whenever a creature you control explores a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on Nicanzil.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a creature you control explores a land card, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Whenever a creature you control explores a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on Nicanzil.

needs.what: a trigger event fired when a creature explores (701.44), with the exploring creature as subject and its controller filterable, carrying the revealed card so a filter can distinguish a land card from a nonland card (e.g. event 'explores' with a 'revealed' filter on types / not_types)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The explore op exists, but trigger_events has no explores event; the nearest are 'surveils' and 'connives', which fire for different keyword actions, and 'permanent_enters'/'counter_placed' would not distinguish the revealed card's land-ness nor fire on a land explore that adds no counter
